# AAPA (American Alliance of Pharmacy Advantage)

> Independent pharmacy group purchasing organization (GPO) providing rebates, advocacy, and community programs for independent pharmacies across the United States.

AAPA serves as a competitive edge for independent pharmacies through GPO purchasing power, legislative advocacy, and partnerships with organizations like McKesson, Health Mart, Inmar, and Live Oak Bank. The organization focuses on strengthening community pharmacy operations through member benefits, immunization programs, and policy lobbying.
